lemmas.name: lc26
lemmas.statement: ∀ (digits : String) (h : letterCombinations_precond digits), letterCombinations_postcond digits (if digits.isEmpty then [] else if digits.toList.any (λ c => ¬(c ∈ ['2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9'])) then [] else digits.toList.map digitToLetters |>.foldl (λ acc ls => acc.flatMap (λ s => ls.map (λ c => s ++ String.singleton c)) ) [""]) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro digits h
  unfold letterCombinations_postcond
  split_ifs <;> simp_all
